Their sum is 48, so we can write an equation: x + 2x + (7/3)x = 48. Multiplying both sides by 3 to get rid of the fraction gives us 9x + 6x + 7x = 144. Combining like terms gives us 22x = 144, so x = 144 / 22 = 6.55 (round down to 6 because we can't have a fraction of a number). The largest number is then 2 * 6 = 12.

Plugging in the values W = 17 + 5(1) = 22 and W = 17 + 5(7) = 52 gives us (52 - 22) / (7 - 1) = 30 / 6 = 5. So, for each year older a boy gets, his weight increases by 5 pounds.
